close_reason: Superseded and closed by the 2026-08-02 emission certificate. The registered next action was a from-scratch beam decode under the datum-blind dispersion objective. That objective is a good global discriminator and a useless local guide, corr 0.0657 with the error-reducing coefficient, and it was then priced directly as a PATH SELECTOR against the reference emission: over the deployed blend plus the seven bases it picks worse than random, pooled 14.3618 against 11.7540 for a seeded random pick, while the per-well oracle over that menu is 5.7307. So the oracle ceiling is menu spread, not information, and neither self consistency nor the reference emission can rank whole paths. Do not build the beam decoder.

Not the closed TVT transfer: TVT = surface + C_w - Z, so transferring TVT carries the donor's Z trajectory while transferring the SURFACE does not. Chain verified at 0.007 ft with the true surface. Cross fit interpolation from offset wells reaches 24.68 ft at k=256, monotone and flattening from 27.09 at k=16, and gates WASH (LEAK blend-add +0.0032, REAL-NULL +0.0005). Averaging the six near parallel surfaces does not help. The base is nevertheless the most decorrelated ever produced here at err-corr 0.327 LEAK and 0.297 NOGEOM against 0.87 to 0.95 for every other base; it fails only on accuracy. The 25 ft is a statement about well spacing versus structural variability, and it implies a sub 6 single model cannot be recovering the surface from neighbours. FOLLOW UPS 2026-08-01, family now fully closed. Half the error is the datum: an oracle per well constant on the identical surface gives 12.3364, beating carry forward 15.9107, while the legal prefix constant gives 24.6753 and misses the oracle by a median 9.30 ft. Algebraically that gap is bias_prefix minus bias_eval, the drift of interpolation bias along the well. Correcting it with an honest leave-one-well-out bias field makes things WORSE at 29.9975, and worse than its own shuffled control at 25.8947, so the bias is the unpredictable innovation exactly as the prior predicted. Prefix fitted linear extrapolation is destructive at 36.9394 and reconfirms the closed prefix dip result. Per donor selection reaches only 48.37. Do not retry a bias field, per donor calibration, or prefix extrapolation. CLOSED AS A FEATURE TOO, 2026-08-02. Added as a fourth channel to the deployed median LightGBM at the identical row step 4 / 1200 tree recipe: standalone 8.5161 to 8.5410 and the same slot swap moves cross fit CV 8.2251 to 8.2514, delta +0.0263, both halves worse, 1 of 5 folds improved. The 0.30 stack error correlation did not convert because the ten deployed feature groups already carry plane_fit and dense_ancc, the same offset well surface interpolation, so the channel adds its 25 ft of noise without new physics. Lesson: a low error correlation against the STACK does not imply a new channel for a BASE. notes/surface_feature_gbdt_2026_08_02.md.

The fixed boundary score passes its emission controls and gives a 17.5165 direct posterior, but its direct seven base add is only -0.0164 and its boundary feature GBDT replacement regresses +0.0076 cross fit. No OOF tuning or kernel port is justified.

Stage 1 on 90 wells at 16 decoys is a clean negative. truth_optimal is 0.000 on all 22 arms against a pre registered bar of 0.20, no paired bootstrap CI on dp_node_err lies below zero, and frac_wells_better_than_raw never exceeds 0.50. All three scored public sources we hold were read in full and every surfaced mechanism was adversarially refuted. Localisation lift over the rolled typewell null peaks at the deployed 800 ft baseline (+0.088) and decays monotonically to exactly 0.000 at full eval span, while the standardised profile value at the truth decays 0.55 to 0.08. Priced and dead in one probe. A PERFECT formation membership oracle scores 25.3311 ft pooled over all 3,783,989 eval rows, worse than carry forward at 15.9107, so no learned classifier over the same labels can help. The reason is that the median well's eval region sits inside exactly ONE formation (median distinct hosts per well = 1.0), so membership is nearly constant along the lateral and carries almost no vertical information, and even perfect membership leaves a within formation true TVT sd of 6.61 ft. Do not build a GR to formation classifier or a formation sequence matcher.

Closed on its own pre-registered bar 2. The peak-height search over the base bank's top-2 singular directions reaches shape RMS 5.3230 against 5.3484, but its ROLLED typewell control reaches 5.3465, so real minus rolled is -0.0234, less than half the 0.05 ft floor. So the basis is expressive and the estimator fails. A 40-well smoke of this arm read -0.1238 real minus rolled, five times the 773-well answer, another instance of the documented subset over-promise alongside cnn_1d_direct. The emission has now been interrogated four distinct ways for per-well SHAPE and refused all four: as a direction (corr 0.099), as a path ranker (worse than random), as a drift estimator (degree 0 wins 5 of 5) and as peak height. It gives the DATUM only, at correlation 0.20. Consequence: reweighting what we own is dead, since a sufficient basis exists in the bank (rank 3 reaches 2.481 ft in sample) and no legal signal can choose its coefficients. Killed by its own falsifier in one pass, both bars failed. Over 773 wells the TRUE per-well datum has a structured fraction of only 0.183 against a 0.20 bar, and NO quantity's short-range semivariogram sits below its position-shuffled interval, so even that 0.183 is not distinguishable from chance. This sharpens the closed surface transfer result, which found an honest leave-one-well-out bias field to be WORSE (29.9975) than its own shuffled control (25.8947): there is no spatial structure to borrow. Do not propose a kriged offset field, a co-kriged surface, or any spatial smoother over per-well datum estimates.

CLOSED FOR GOOD, and the axis text itself was corrected first: the originally proposed global slope and gain decoder was already closed by QUEUE.md, and the premise was wrong since the E2 GR calibration is already global while it is the local TVT GRADIENT that is profiled per window. The experiment actually run is the one neither closed form changed, the OBJECTIVE: the certified global affine objective made sequential by alternating a 2-parameter per-well calibration with an exact Viterbi over TVT cells, which is the smaller state construction with the predeclared emission reduction the record demanded. On 153 fold-zero wells the truth beats the decoder's optimum on 0.000 of them, as total a failure as the profiled emission's 0 of 90, with the rolled arm identical at 0.000 and the decoded RMSE 9.393 against 5.283 for the path it started from. THE REASON GENERALISES: the certificate and the decoder share an objective and reach opposite verdicts, so what breaks is the DIMENSION OF THE SEARCH. One parameter, a rigid shift, gives truth wins on 76 percent; two parameters give no signal either way; 65^25 paths give the truth losing on every well. The emission is a sound discriminator over a low-dimensional family and an unsound objective for free path search. Do not build another decoder for this observable in any form.

Bar 1 failed. Combining the prefix with the typewell gives weighted correlation 0.2351 against 0.2378 for the typewell alone, so it dilutes rather than adds, and the prefix on its own reaches only 0.0402 with an interval containing zero. Only 283 of 773 wells retained a prefix estimate, capping any gain independently. THE LESSON GENERALISES: oracle R^2 at the TRUE TVT is the wrong figure of merit for a reference log and this project had been implicitly using it as one. Localisation depends on CONTRAST between the truth and nearby WRONG offsets, not on fit at the truth, and the two come apart here: the prefix wins on oracle R^2, 0.4560 against 0.4147, and loses on window-level hit rate, 0.143 to 0.204 within 2 ft against 0.191 to 0.261, over rolled controls near 0.11 for both. Do not re-propose a within-well reference on the strength of its oracle R^2; measure its contrast first, which costs one probe.

Bar 1 was not met as literally written and bar 2 failed outright. The bucket analysis looked strong, within-2ft rising 0.037 to 0.398, 0.062 to 0.447 and 0.082 to 0.451 across agreement quintiles with agreement correlating with isolation at only -0.13 to -0.17, but the ROLLED arm was NOT flat, rising 0.029 to 0.250, because a window agreeing with its neighbours is pulled toward the centre of the argmax distribution and the true offsets are centred too, so agreement buys hits by centring alone. End to end the cross-fit selected q_dev = 1.0, DISABLING the agreement gate, in all five folds, so the combined arm equals isolation-only to +0.0000. Whatever survives the confound is already imposed by the estimator's Gaussian prior, which centres as well. Do not re-propose a consistency filter over window estimates in gate or weight form.

DELIVERED, the largest single step of the session, and now at its optimum on both sides. SMOOTH 5, a 2.5 ft boxcar inherited from the probe the module grew out of, was smoothing across the recorded 1 to 2 ft GR correlation length. Over 773 wells the ROLLED arm is flat at 0.108 to 0.123 at every resolution while the real top-trust hit rate at L=400 runs 0.379 at 0.5 ft, 0.337 at 2.5 ft and 0.229 at 4.5 ft. Fully cross-fitted this moves correlation 0.2000 to 0.2718 and CV 8.1326 to 8.0435, five folds of five, against rolled +0.0415, across-well shuffle +0.0208 and global scalar +0.0158. Shipped as 55190292. The MIRROR is closed as a negative: query-side GR smoothing hurts monotonically, 0.2718 raw falling to 0.1806 at a 15-row boxcar, so the E2 family's sg5 KEEPs do not transfer. One lesson from both sides: smoothing either log destroys the high-frequency content that discriminates, with no compensating noise reduction because the window R^2 already averages hundreds of rows. ISOLATION_FT is flat over 1 to 8 ft and was deliberately not retuned.

Bar 1 failed as completely as possible. Holding one affine calibration per WELL, fitted against the deployed path, gives correlation -0.0441 and CV 8.2466, worse than doing nothing and indistinguishable from its own rolled control at real minus rolled -0.0022, against the per-window incumbent's 0.2718 and 8.0435. Per-window calibration is load-bearing, not excess freedom. THE LESSON NEEDED SHARPENING AND NOW HAS IT: not all nuisance freedom is equal and the distinction is geometric. The decoder's per-node freedom is over the local TVT GRADIENT, which MOVES the implied path and lets the objective explain GR at a wrong TVT by bending geometry. The window's affine refit is over GR AMPLITUDE, orthogonal to TVT, which cannot shift a peak and only absorbs the real variation in tool response and facies along a 5,000 ft lateral. Freedom that can move the implied TVT is harmful; freedom orthogonal to TVT is necessary. Per the pre-registered bar, the remaining error is in the emission's INFORMATION rather than its freedom.

The falsifier PASSED and the build then closed the axis anyway, which is the informative outcome. The dip is strongly spatially structured where the datum is not: gamma/sill 0.347 at under 2,500 ft against a shuffled interval of [0.945, 1.049], monotone to a sill by about 5,000 ft, so 65 percent of dip variance is shared between nearby wells. But a cross-fitted inverse-distance dip field correlates with the true dip at 0.8646 while OUR OWN PATH'S dip already correlates at 0.9967, so the cross-fitted blend selects 0.0 in all five folds and CV moves by exactly 0.0000. Our dip residual is 8.2 percent of the dip's spread; the field leaves about 50 percent. This is the sharp reason structural surface transfer failed at 24.68 ft, which that axis never had. ALSO CORRECTS Part 6: the datum is not spatially white, it carries about 31 percent structure within 2,500 ft; that bar and this one were both mis-specified by averaging bins beyond the variogram's range. The last neighbour route is closed. Do not re-propose transferring the surface, its gradient, or the datum from neighbours.

Both bars fail. Twenty named per-well observables, deliberately narrow because width is poison at 773 wells, reach cross-fitted weighted correlation 0.1956 with the dip residual against a 0.20 bar, converting through the cross-fitted global scalar to only -0.0200 ft against a 0.05 floor and this repo's ~0.10 ft per-well resolution limit. TERMINAL FINDING as pre-registered: the 8.2251 decomposes into a datum of 6.2943 now solved to correlation 0.27 and banked at -0.18 ft, a linear shape half of 3.7795 which is an unpredictable dip residual, and a non-linear half of 3.7081 for which no mechanism was identified at any point. The emission gives the datum and nothing else. This is not a claim that shape is unreachable in principle, since the certificate says a 1 to 2 ft path makes the datum nearly free and competitors reach 5.4 to 6.8 with single models, but no combination of this project's observables, models or neighbour information produces one.

REAL and NEGLIGIBLE. The falsifier passed strongly: curvature is as spatially structured as the dip, 0.652 within 2,500 ft with all five short bins below their shuffled intervals, and unlike the dip our own path captures it poorly at 0.3915. The cross-fitted field raises that to 0.4798 and puts real weight on itself, 0.3 to 0.6, in all five folds, with shape falling to 5.2893 and real minus shuffled -0.0538. All three pre-registered bars pass. It is worth 0.0035 ft of CV and is NOT shipped. The bars were under-specified, asking for direction and controls but never for magnitude, and this repo's floor is that CV cannot resolve a per-well correction below ~0.10 ft. The reason the magnitude is small is informative: the pure quadratic term is a thin slice of the 3.7081 ft non-linear remainder, which is variation on scales shorter than a well and cannot be reached by a second derivative. Closes neighbour transfer of every derivative of the surface; the Part 16 terminal finding stands unqualified.

STALE AND REFUTED BY ITS OWN FIRST STEP, which is the outcome it was designed to allow. The axis was opened on Part 18's conclusion that the residual is geology below the well scale. Its registered first step, the structure function of the non-linear remainder, was run and inverted the premise: over all 3,783,989 rows the content below 400 ft of MD is 0.6189 ft, just 0.57 percent of the total error variance, while the datum is 58.6 percent. Part 18's statistic had compared the error in TVT space against the truth in U space, and since TVT = U - Z with Z known exactly the denominator was inflated by the survey trajectory. The error is overwhelmingly LONG scale, so no short-scale or high-resolution mechanism is worth building, and the AWS pivot this axis implied was cancelled before any spend.

Both quantified bars fail and the premise was wrong. Averaging the per-well estimate over all 256 grid points gives correlation 0.2217 against the selected incumbent's 0.2718 and CV 8.1047 against 8.0435, worse by 0.0612 ft. I called the surface nearly flat on the strength of the ISOLATION-RADIUS sweep, which varied a different parameter; the main grid is not flat, contains genuinely worse settings, and averaging over them dilutes rather than de-noises. Instructive against Part 10, where a genuinely flat surface meant the argmax should NOT be taken: whether to select or to average is an empirical question about the particular surface, not a methodological preference. The datum estimator has now survived five distinct attempts to improve it and is likely at its ceiling for this observable.

CLOSED WITHOUT THE REBUILD, because the rebuild would have produced candidates nobody can choose between. The ceiling is real and large: a per-well ORACLE blend weight capped at 0.36 gives -0.336 ft with the PF and -1.334 with apparentdip_recent. But the oracle alpha is not makeable. Regressed on 20 narrow observables and converted through a cross-fitted global shrinkage, the rule 3 comparator, higher correlation gives monotonically WORSE CV: 0.107 costs +0.069, 0.201 costs +0.333, 0.365 costs +0.711, with fitted shrinkages at 0.91 to 1.02 so the estimator will not even damp itself. THE LESSON GENERALISES: the datum frontier's correlation-to-gain mapping is specific to an ADDITIVE correction under quadratic loss, where a global shrinkage can always damp the estimate to safety. A blend weight enters multiplicatively against a far worse partner and its oracle is zero on 44.5 percent of wells, so the loss is sharply asymmetric and a correlation of 0.365 is still destructive. Check that a target enters the loss the way the datum does before quoting a correlation threshold for it.

Correlation with the true datum runs 0.186, 0.179, 0.220, 0.272, 0.270, 0.240, 0.257 at widths 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 30, and CV 8.1417, 8.1488, 8.1066, 8.0435, 8.0457, 8.0864, 8.0629. The optimum is at 16 with a broad plateau to 20. Narrowing hurts for the pre-registered reason: a narrow box TRUNCATES large true datums, and with datum RMS 6.29 ft a +/-8 box clips past one sigma. USEFUL CONTRAST: two constants were inherited unexamined from the same probe, and the 2.5 ft boxcar was badly wrong while the 16 ft box was already optimal. Finding one wrong does not license assuming the rest are; sweep and measure each time.

Run 2026-08-03, both registered bars measured. Bar 1 PASSES: lgbmede2ratecoupledwindowevidencefeature_2026_08_03 gated KEEP at standalone 8.4788, the best single base in the repo, NOGEOM blend-add -0.4310 against a rolled null -0.0534, REAL-NULL -0.3776. Bar 2 passes on its literal wording, since setK containing it reaches corrected CV 7.9811 against 8.0435, but the inference bar 2 was written to support does NOT hold: the same set WITHOUT it, setK-keeponly, reaches 7.9772, so its marginal contribution to the corrected path is -0.0039, slightly negative. The per-well constant had already extracted essentially all of the window evidence. Three further attacks the same day agree that the channel is exhausted rather than under-used: ten matching statistics, none beating the incumbent cross-correlation at rho 0.2762; a best-window oracle at 0.9094 on real profiles against 0.8925 on ROLLED ones, leaving +0.0168 of believable selection headroom; and learned pooling over 31 evidence features at 0.2141 against the hand-built 0.2802. The base also cannot ship: its fold models were never saved and no inference path exists for its five feature columns.

The correction stays at the END, now for a measured reason rather than convenience. Four insertion points cross-fitted: after everything 8.0435, on the blend before post processing 8.1686, per base before the Ridge 8.1697, on the Ridge output 8.1760. Bar 1 fails for every alternative. A per-well constant PROVABLY commutes with the post processing, verified at max 2.5e-11 ft over 3,783,989 rows, because savgol at polyorder 3 represents a degree-0 signal exactly and a constant shift of the ordinate leaves the U-projection's IRLS residuals invariant so its weights and fit shape are unchanged. So moving only the APPLICATION is a no-op; the arms differ because the ESTIMATE moves. And that is why the end wins: estimate quality tracks the accuracy of the path it is built around, correlation 0.2718 at the final blend, 0.1915 at the stack, 0.1613 at the pre-postproc blend, 0.0601 on a 26.68 ft base. That is the dose-response curve applied to our own pipeline, and the fully post-processed blend is the most accurate path it ever holds.

CLOSED 2026-08-03 on a measured bound. The axis expected the BASE BANK to be the constraint; it is not, and the close comes from the other half of the question. Step 1, the bank ceiling, PASSES: reports/probe_shape_bank_ceiling_2026_08_02.json fits per-well coefficients against each well's own truth and reaches shape RMS 0.653 at rank 20 and 0.176 at full rank, so the 150-base bank can express a sub-0.6 shape with hindsight. Step 2, the selector, FAILS and cannot be rescued. reports/probe_shape_selector_bound_2026_08_03.json decomposes the shape error of the current best path, pred_setk_keeponly_trustdatum_2026_08_03.npy at CV 7.9772 and shape RMS 5.2860, onto per-well orthonormal polynomials in normalised MD, a basis that is COMPARABLE ACROSS WELLS and therefore one a selector could target at all. Degree 1 alone carries 14.2262 of the 27.94 total shape variance, 50.9 percent. Cross-fitted rho on that coefficient from a narrow named observable set is 0.2064 against a permutation null p95 of 0.1014, so it is real and small, and it is the LARGEST value anything in this repo has reached on it: the trajectory probe got 0.1453 with a GBDT over 114 features and the slope screen 0.1525 with selection nested inside the fold over 217. THE BOUND. Residual shape variance is sum_k v_k (1 - rho_k^2), so fixing rho_1 at what we measure and granting PERFECT rho = 1 on every higher degree and on the entire unmodelled remainder floors shape RMS at 3.6906 ft, 6.2x the 0.6 bar. The bound is insensitive to any plausible selector improvement: rho_1 = 0.28, the hard cap the typewell channel reaches on any per-well quantity in this repo, gives 3.6209; rho_1 = 0.5 gives 3.2664; rho_1 = 0.7 gives 2.6936; even rho_1 = 0.90 gives 1.6441, still nearly 3x the bar. Reaching 0.6 requires rho_1 >= 0.9873 AND perfection on every other degree simultaneously. Measured honestly across all 12 degrees, the observable stock moves shape RMS from 5.2860 to 5.2230, a total of 0.063 ft. CONSEQUENCE. Global monotone alignment stays closed, because its crossover with the gated-window estimator sits at about 0.6 ft of shape RMS and no legal selector approaches it. The per-well datum is therefore settled at rho 0.28 for this competition, and the 2.9303 ft datum prize is not reachable with the information this repo owns. The one caveat stated plainly: the bound is conditional on the observable stock, so a genuinely NEW information channel could raise rho_1 -- but three independent screens this session, 132 observables against the per-well constant, 217 against the slope and 234 including cross-well surface gradients, all concluded that the typewell GR match is the only channel carrying anything and that it is capped by identifiability geometry rather than by method.

Closed 2026-08-04. The axis asked for a channel outside the screened observable stock that could beat the rho-0.28 identifiability limit. None was found, and the datum channel was closed a fourth way (robust consensus aggregators all lose to the incumbent mean). What moved CV instead was not a new channel at all: it was aiming existing components at the right quantity. 8.2251 -> 7.2732 came from the sequence loss, the query smoothing, prediction-start resampling, the post-processing cell and seed averaging. Recording the honest result the axis asked for: the per-well datum and shape are settled at rho about 0.28 and rho_1 about 0.21 for this competition.
next_action: ONE quantity is binding and it is rho_1, the cross-fitted correlation with the per-well DEGREE-1 shape coefficient. Residual shape variance is sum_k v_k (1 - rho_k^2) over per-well orthonormal polynomials in normalised MD, and degree 1 alone carries 50.9 percent of it. Granting PERFECT reconstruction on every other degree and the entire remainder, and holding rho_1 at the 0.2064 we measure, shape RMS floors at 3.6906 ft against the 0.6 ft that would unlock global alignment. The conversion: rho_1 0.2064 -> 3.6905 ft, 0.50 -> 3.2664, 0.70 -> 2.6936, 0.90 -> 1.6441, and 0.9873 -> 0.5992. THE BAR, quantified: raise cross-fitted rho_1 above 0.40, which is roughly double anything measured and still only reaches 3.53 ft, as a proof-of-channel milestone; the full unlock needs 0.9873 together with perfection elsewhere and should be treated as out of reach unless something structural changes. WHAT DOES NOT QUALIFY, so nobody repeats it: another sweep of the existing observable stock. Three screens this session covered 132 observables against the per-well constant, 217 against the slope, and 234 including cross-well surface gradients and all 24 banked marker surfaces differenced along MD. Every one concluded that the typewell GR match is the only channel carrying anything and that it is capped near rho 0.28 by IDENTIFIABILITY rather than by method: hit-within-1-ft runs 7.0 / 12.6 / 24.4 percent from low to high TVT travel across a window against a rolled control flat at 5.8, so a window where the well barely moves observes one bed and cannot localise against a log whose beds repeat. A qualifying proposal must NAME a channel outside that stock and state the mechanism by which it could exceed the identifiability limit. If none exists, close this axis and record that the per-well datum and shape are settled at rho 0.28 and 0.21 for this competition, which is a real and reportable result. PIN BLAS THREADS.

why: Virtual prediction-start resampling does two things at once and only one was expected. It augments, worth -0.25 ft, and it DECORRELATES seeds of the same recipe, taking pairwise error correlation from the usual 0.8893-0.9176 down to 0.7706-0.8039, which makes seed averaging worth -0.16 ft where it paid the CNN family -0.0102. Cross-RECIPE averaging adds nothing (mean pairwise correlation flat at 0.787-0.801 across pools mixing psr2/psr4/psr8, three schedule lengths, two widths and two smoothing levels), so the diversity is a property of the training draw. The open question is how far the seed axis goes and whether the diversity can be deepened at fixed member count.
